paper_title: Effect of Fecal Microbiota Transplantation on Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial

pico.patient: person with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
pico.outcome: investigate the clinical efficacy and safety of FMT for patients with NAFLD, elucidating its different influences on lean and obese patients with NAFLD.

supplement: Samples of comparison group are not collected. Only 10 samples in intervention group are collected.
